title: How to Cancel Medium — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Medium membership in 60 seconds. Stop the $5/mo charge and go back to 3 free articles per month.
intro: Medium membership is one of the easiest subscriptions to cancel — done in three clicks from your settings page. You keep access to your own published stories.

steps.title: Go to Medium membership settings
steps.text: Visit medium.com/me/settings/membership while signed in. Or click your avatar → Settings → Membership.

steps.title: Click "Cancel membership"
steps.text: Find the "Cancel membership" option on the membership page and click it.

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Click "Confirm" on the dialog. Your member access continues until the end of your billing period. After that, you're back to 3 free articles per month.
steps.tip: Your own published stories remain live and accessible to readers regardless of your membership status.

warnings: After cancellation, you get 3 free member articles per month (Medium's metered paywall).
Your published stories remain live — membership status doesn't affect your writing.
If enrolled in the Partner Program, your earnings continue for past articles even after canceling.
If subscribed through Apple/Google, cancel through their platforms.

faqs.q: Can I still read Medium after canceling?
faqs.a: Yes, but limited to 3 member-only articles per month. Non-member articles (marked as free) are unlimited. Your own stories are always accessible.

faqs.q: Will I still earn from the Partner Program?
faqs.a: Yes. Your published stories continue earning from member reading time regardless of your own membership status.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Medium?
faqs.a: Medium doesn't advertise refunds, but you can contact support for recent charges. They handle requests case-by-case.

faqs.q: How do I read Medium for free?
faqs.a: You get 3 free member articles per month. Using incognito/private browsing, or reading via links shared on social media, sometimes bypasses the paywall.

refund.details: Medium doesn't typically offer refunds. Your access continues through the end of your billing period. Contact support for billing errors.

retentionTactics: Medium doesn't use aggressive retention tactics. Cancellation is clean and quick.
